decisionsTitle: «Afiș» set in Poppins, each weekly series written once in its weekday's head
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-27,** of «Afiș» (§856, §857): «the font is pretty ugly», then «I need to organize it better and use the space more efficiently»; of three layouts drawn for the same three months, the owner chose «seriile în cap».

**The face.** The poster is set in one geometric sans, Poppins (SIL OFL 1.1, `public/fonts/calendar/`, from fontsource): the month in italic Black with its year in italic Medium, «EVENIMENTE» in spaced Medium capitals echoing the logo's lettering, titles in Bold, hours in Medium. The dialog fetches its five faces (Latin and Latin Extended, 68 KB) when it first opens, so no other page pays for them (`calendar-image-fonts.ts`). The other four styles draw as before.

**The space.** The band is one line — the logo left, «EVENIMENTE» and the month right — about half its old height. A weekly series is written once, in full, as a strip under its weekday's head, with its hour; each of its dates shows only its glyph and hour, or «Anulat». The cells are left to the dates that are not routine: a special date's title in full on its tint, with its hour. The specials' legend sits in the empty days before the 1st or after the last day, or in a slim strip when there are none; a series that is not on one weekday falls back to a chip in its cells and a legend line.

**Seeing it.** `yarn calendar:preview` draws the picture without a server or a database from three months in `scripts/calendar-image-preview/` (June 2026 as the club's own poster had it, a busy six-week August in English, a November with two dates), every format, into `dist/calendar-preview/`, with the dialog's own fonts and drawing.
changelogLine: - **The calendar picture, reorganised** — «Afiș» is set in a cleaner face, its band takes half the room, a weekly run is written once under its weekday and its dates show the hour, and special dates keep their whole title. §NNN.
